name: Kavik's Tower

sub_locations.name: The Lower Courses
sub_locations.description: Twenty-two storeys of red sandstone, of which four remain standing and the rest lie in roughly the order they fell.

sub_locations.name: The Stair Shaft
sub_locations.description: The stair survives because it was cut into the core rather than built against it. It goes up into daylight and down into water.

sub_locations.name: The Flooded Undercroft
sub_locations.description: Below the waterline the sandstone is cold and the carving is sharper, having been spared four hundred years of weather.

description: Four storeys of red sandstone where the chronicles promise twenty-two.
arrival: It did not topple. It sat down. The upper courses came straight through the lower ones and the whole thing settled into the delta mud like a foot into silt, which is why four storeys are still square and true and everything above them is a slope of dressed stone.
notes: Kavik's tower, the landmark settlement_lothal records. Enterable rather than merely visited, and the undercroft gates on knowing the safe channels -- a player who has not done the mangrove work cannot reach the best of it.
